caption: The drawing consists of a rectangular composition featuring a variety of decorative motifs and borders in green, blue, and black on a cream background. Across the top, there is a horizontal band with a repeating pattern of green and black arch shapes enclosing radial floral motifs, interspersed with small dot accents. Below this, a row of stylized green and black leafy palm-like shapes and fan motifs occupies the central part, with three vertical green leafy heart shapes in the center. Leafy garlands form twisted border patterns on the left and as horizontal bands; one near the middle and another near the bottom, both rendered in green. Two thick horizontal blue bands, one above and one below the lower garland, separate sections of the composition. The bottom area contains three circular wreath-like motifs made up of small green leaves. The entire arrangement is contained within a lightly outlined rectangular frame on a plain cream-colored sheet.
title: Stencilled Wall Decoration
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
